QUOTE: "when `hasSearch` is true, it renders `<NavigationSearch {...searchProps} ... ref={ref} />` (lines 128–137)" and "when `hasSearch` is false, `NavigationHeader` drops the ref entirely, because the `NavigationSearch` branch is skipped. A ref passed alongside `hasSearch={false}` would silently stay `null`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says NavigationHeader forwards its ref to NavigationSearch only when `hasSearch` is true, and that with `hasSearch` false the ref stays attached to nothing (`null`).
